# Media fixtures

These synthetic clips are generated from FFmpeg's `testsrc2` source and contain no third-party footage.

- `avc-bframes-fragmented.mp4`: H.264 fragmented MP4 with B-frames.
- `avc-multi-fragment-long-gop.mp4`: H.264 long-GOP stream split into eight 0.25-second fragments with only one IDR frame.
- `avc-mid-gop-fragmented.mp4`: H.264 fragmented MP4 beginning with delta frames before its first keyframe.
- `vp9-recording.webm`: VP9 WebM matching the recording container.
- `av1-fragmented.mp4`: AV1 fragmented MP4 covering a second live codec.
